2. CSS (style.css)

CSS
/* ================= CATEGORIES SECTION STYLING ================= */
.categories-section {
    padding: 60px 5%;
    background-color: #fffcf5;
}

.categories-container {
    max-width: 1300px;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.categories-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
    gap: 20px;
}

.category-card {
    background: #fffdf9;
    border-radius: 24px;
    padding: 30px 15px 25px 15px;
    text-align: center;
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 230, 235, 0.6);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.category-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(255, 105, 135, 0.12);
}

/* Background Soft Pink Blob inside each card */
.cat-blob-bg {
    position: absolute;
    top: 20px;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    width: 80px;
    height: 70px;
    background: #ffe3ec;
    border-radius: 50%;
    z-index: 1;
}

.cat-icon-wrapper {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    width: 70px;
    height: 70px;
    margin: 0 auto 15px auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.cat-icon-wrapper img {
    max-width: 100%;
    max-height: 100%;
    object-fit: contain;
}

.category-card h3 {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 800;
    color: #2f2e41;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

.category-card p {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #777;
    margin-bottom: 25px;
}

.cat-arrow-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    background: #ffe3ec;
    color: #ff4757;
    border-radius: 50%;
    font-size: 12px;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.category-card:hover .cat-arrow-btn {
    background: #ff4757;
    color: #ffffff;
    transform: scale(1.1);
}

/* Responsive Layout */
@media (max-width: 1200px) {
    .categories-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
        gap: 20px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .categories-grid {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 15px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 480px) {
    .categories-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

CSS
/* ================= CUSTOMER REVIEWS SECTION STYLING ================= */
.reviews-section {
    padding: 70px 5%;
    background-color: #fffcf5;
    text-align: center;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.reviews-container {
    max-width: 1300px;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.reviews-slider {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 30px;
    margin-top: 40px;
}

.review-card {
    background: #ffffff;
    padding: 35px 25px;
    border-radius: 24px;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 220, 225, 0.6);
    text-align: left;
    position: relative;
    /* Entrance Animation */
    opacity: 0;
    transform: translateY(30px);
    animation: fadeInUp 0.8s ease forwards;
    transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
}

/* Staggered Animation Delay for cards */
.review-card:nth-child(1) { animation-delay: 0.2s; }
.review-card:nth-child(2) { animation-delay: 0.4s; }
.review-card:nth-child(3) { animation-delay: 0.6s; }

.review-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-8px);
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(255, 105, 135, 0.12);
}

.review-stars {
    color: #ffaa00;
    font-size: 14px;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.review-text {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #555;
    line-height: 1.7;
    margin-bottom: 25px;
    font-style: italic;
}

.reviewer-info {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 15px;
    border-top: 1px solid #f2f2f2;
    padding-top: 15px;
}

.reviewer-img {
    width: 50px;
    height: 50px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 2px solid #ff4757;
}

.reviewer-img img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
}

.reviewer-info h4 {
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #2f2e41;
    margin-bottom: 2px;
}

.reviewer-info span {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #888;
}

/* Keyframe Animations */
@keyframes fadeInUp {
    to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
}

/* Responsive View */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .reviews-slider {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    }
}

@media (max-width: 768px) {
    .reviews-slider {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

HTML
<!-- High-End Footer Section -->
<footer class="footer-section">
    <div class="footer-container">
        
        <!-- Column 1: Brand Info & Logo -->
        <div class="footer-col brand-col">
            <div class="footer-logo">
                <img src="LOGO.jpg" alt="Temptations Bakery Logo">
                <h3>Temptations Bakery</h3>
            </div>
            <p class="footer-about">
                Spreading happiness, one sweet bite at a time. We craft premium, hand-baked goods fresh daily with love and the finest ingredients.

        <!-- Column 2: Quick Links -->

            <h3>Quick Links</h3>

                <li><a href="#">About Us</a></li>
                <li><a href="#">Our Specialties</a></li>

    </div>

    <!-- Bottom Copyright Bar -->
    <div class="footer-bottom">
        <p>&copy; 2026 Temptations Bakery. All rights reserved. Crafted with 💖 for sweet lovers.</p>
    </div>
</footer>

2. CSS (style.css mein yeh add karein)

CSS
/* ================= HIGH-END FOOTER STYLING ================= */
.footer-section {
    background-color: #26242c;
    color: #f7f3ed;
    padding: 70px 5% 20px 5%;
    font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
}

.footer-container {
    max-width: 1300px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr 1.2fr 1.3fr;
    gap: 40px;
    padding-bottom: 50px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.footer-col h3 {
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: 700;
    color: #ffffff;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    position: relative;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* Brand Column */
.footer-logo {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
}

.footer-logo img {
    width: 45px;
    height: 45px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    object-fit: cover;
}

.footer-logo h3 {
    margin-bottom: 0;
    font-size: 20px;
    color: #ff527b;
}

.footer-about {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #bbb;
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

.footer-socials {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
}

.social-icon {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
    color: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 14px;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.social-icon:hover {
    background: #ff527b;
    transform: translateY(-3px);
}

/* Quick Links Column */
.footer-links {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
}

.footer-links li {
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.footer-links a {
    color: #bbb;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 13px;
    transition: color 0.3s ease, padding-left 0.3s ease;
}

.footer-links a:hover {
    color: #ff527b;
    padding-left: 5px;
}

/* Working Hours Column */
.footer-hours {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
}

.footer-hours li {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #bbb;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.footer-hours span {
    color: #ffffff;
    font-weight: 600;
    display: block;
}

/* Newsletter Column */
.newsletter-col p {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #bbb;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.newsletter-form {
    display: flex;
    background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.07);
    border-radius: 30px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1);
}

.newsletter-form input {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    padding: 12px 18px;
    color: #fff;
    font-size: 13px;
    width: 100%;
    outline: none;
}

.newsletter-form input::placeholder {
    color: #888;
}

.newsletter-form button {
    background: #ff527b;
    border: none;
    color: #white;
    padding: 0 20px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.3s ease;
}

.newsletter-form button:hover {
    background: #e04368;
}

/* Footer Bottom */
.footer-bottom {
    text-align: center;
    padding-top: 20px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #888;
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .footer-container {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 30px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 576px) {
    .footer-container {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}

    margin-bottom: 20px;
}

/* Social Icons with Original Brand Colors */
.footer-socials {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
}

.social-icon {
    width: 38px;
    height: 38px;
    background: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 15px;
    text-decoration: none;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
}

.social-icon:hover {
    transform: translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 15px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
}

/* Original Brand Colors */
.social-icon.facebook { color: #1877f2; }
.social-icon.instagram { color: #e4405f; }
.social-icon.tiktok { color: #010101; }
.social-icon.whatsapp { color: #25d366; }

/* Quick Links Column */
.footer-links {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
}

.footer-links li {
    margin-bottom: 10px;
}

.footer-links a {
    color: #666;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 13px;
    transition: color 0.3s ease, padding-left 0.3s ease;
}

.footer-links a:hover {
    color: #ff4757;
    padding-left: 5px;
}

/* Working Hours Column */
.footer-hours {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
}

.footer-hours li {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #666;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.footer-hours span {
    color: #2f2e41;
    font-weight: 600;
    display: block;
}

/* Newsletter Column */
.newsletter-col p {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #666;
    margin-bottom: 15px;
    line-height: 1.5;
}

.newsletter-form {
    display: flex;
    background: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 30px;
    overflow: hidden;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.4);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.03);
}

.newsletter-form input {
    background: transparent;
    border: none;
    padding: 12px 18px;
    color: #333;
    font-size: 13px;
    width: 100%;
    outline: none;
}

.newsletter-form input::placeholder {
    color: #999;
}

.newsletter-form button {
    background: #ff4757;
    border: none;
    color: #ffffff;
    padding: 0 20px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.3s ease;
}

.newsletter-form button:hover {
    background: #e04368;
}

/* Footer Bottom */
.footer-bottom {
    text-align: center;
    padding-top: 20px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #777;
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .footer-container {
        grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
        gap: 30px;
    }
}

@media (max-width: 576px) {
    .footer-container {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    }
}
You said ab isko github ke though vercel per live link generate karegy hum to meri help kro is mai mujhy guid…

ab isko github ke though vercel per live link generate karegy hum to meri help kro is mai mujhy guide kro kya kya krna hai

Gemini said

Apni website ko GitHub ke zariye Vercel par live karna bohot asaan hai! Neeche step-by-step guide di gayi hai, isko follow karein:

Step 1: GitHub par Repository Banayein aur Code Push Karein

  1. GitHub (github.com) par apni profile mein login karein.

  2. Upar right corner par '+' icon par click karke 'New repository' select karein.

  3. Repository ka naam dein (misal ke taur par: temptations-bakery), usko Public ya Private select karein, aur Create repository par click kar dein.

  4. Ab apne computer par project folder mein terminal ya Git Bash open karein aur yeh commands chalayein:

    Bash
    git init
git add .
git commit -m "Initial commit - Temptations Bakery website"
git branch -M main
git remote add origin <aapki-github-repository-ka-url>
git push -u origin main

Step 2: Vercel par Account Banayein aur Login Karein

  1. Vercel (vercel.com) ki website par jayein.

  2. Sign Up ya Login par click karein aur "Continue with GitHub" ka option choose karein. Is se aapka GitHub account Vercel ke sath connect ho jayega.

Step 3: Vercel par Project Deploy Karein

  1. Vercel dashboard mein aane ke baad, upar ya beech mein "Add New..." ya "Create a New Project" ka button hoga, us par click karein.

  2. Aapko apni GitHub repositories ki list dikh jayegi. Usme se apne bakery project (temptations-bakery) ke samne wale "Import" button par click karein.

  3. Configure Project ka page open hoga:

    • Project Name: Yeh khud-ba-khud utha lega.

    • Framework Preset: Agar aapka project HTML/CSS/JS mein hai toh yeh automatic detect kar lega (agar Vite/React hai toh Vite select ho jayega).

    • Baaki settings ko waisa hi rehne dein aur neeche "Deploy" ke button par click kar dein.

Step 4: Live Link Hasil Karein!

  • Deploying process shuru ho jayegi aur kuch hi seconds mein mukammal ho jayegi.

  • Success hone ke baad ek celebration screen aayegi aur aapko Live Domain Link (jaise temptations-bakery.vercel.app) mil jayega!

Aap is link ko click karke apni live website kahin bhi share kar sakte hain. Agar kahin koi masla aaye toh batayein, main foran guide kar dunga!

Gemini said

Bohot badhiya! Aapka code GitHub par successfully push ho chuka hai, jaisa ke aapke terminal screenshot mein clearly nazar aa raha hai.

Ab aapka GitHub setup mukammal ho gaya hai. Agla step yeh hai ke aap Vercel ke zariye live link generate karein:

  • Step 1: Vercel.com par jayein aur "Continue with GitHub" par click karke login ya sign up kar lein.

  • Step 2: Vercel dashboard mein aane ke baad upar ya side par "Add New..." ya "Create a New Project" ke button par click karein.

  • Step 3: Apni repositories ki list mein se Bakery project ko talash karein aur uske samne diye gaye "Import" button par click karein.

  • Step 4: Project configure page aayega, wahan baaki settings ko waise hi rehne dein aur neeche "Deploy" ke button par click kar dein.

Bas kuch hi seconds mein deployment complete ho jayegi aur aapko aapki website ka live Vercel domain link mil jayega! Agar kahin koi confusion ho toh batayein.

Gemini said

Yahan error isliye aa raha hai kyunke Vercel ki naming convention ke mutabiق project name mein uppercase letters (capital letters) allowed nahi hain.

Aap Project Name (BakeryTemp09) ko small letters mein change kar dein, misal ke taur par: bakery-temp09 ya temptations-bakery

Name ko lowercase karne ke baad error khatam ho jayega, phir aap neeche diye gaye Deploy button par click kar dein. Aapka project foran live ho jayega!

CSS
/* ================= HEADER STYLING ================= */
.site-header {
    position: relative;
    background-color: #fffcf5; /* Match base pastel theme */
    width: 100%;
    z-index: 1000;
}

/* --- 1. Thinner Top Pink Bar --- */
.top-announcement-bar {
    background-color: #ffb6c1; /* Soft pink color */
    color: #2f2e41;
    padding: 6px 5%; /* Thinner height */
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.5);
}

.top-bar-container {
    max-width: 1300px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
}

.top-left-info, .top-right-info {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
}

.top-left-info i, .top-right-info i {
    color: #ff4757;
}

.top-left-info .dot, .top-right-info .sep {
    color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.top-right-info a {
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
}

.top-socials {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
}

.top-socials a {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    background: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #ff4757;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
}

.top-socials a:hover {
    transform: scale(1.1);
}

/* --- 2. Main Navigation & Hidden Logo Background --- */
.main-navbar {
    background-color: #fffcf5;
    padding: 15px 5%;
}

.nav-container {
    max-width: 1300px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

.nav-menu {
    list-style: none;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 30px;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
}

.nav-menu a {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #2f2e41;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 15px;
    position: relative;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-menu a.active, .nav-menu a:hover {
    color: #ff4757;
}

.nav-menu a.active::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -6px;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 3px;
    background-color: #ff4757;
    border-radius: 2px;
}

/* Logo: Circle background and drop-shadow hidden */
.header-logo-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.clean-logo {
    height: 90px;
    width: auto;
    background: transparent !important;
    border-radius: 0 !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    border: none !important;
    object-fit: contain;
}

.nav-actions {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 15px;
}

.search-btn {
    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid #ffe3ec;
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #2f2e41;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 15px;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.search-btn:hover {
    background: #ffe3ec;
    color: #ff4757;
}

.btn-order-now {
    background: #ff4757;
    color: #ffffff;
    padding: 12px 24px;
    border-radius: 30px;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 14px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(255, 71, 87, 0.3);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.btn-order-now:hover {
    background: #e04368;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* --- 3. Bottom Umbrella / Scalloped Wave Edge --- */
.umbrella-bottom-border {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 18px;
    line-height: 0;
    background-color: #fffcf5;
}

.umbrella-bottom-border svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}

CSS
/* Base Reset */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
}

body {
    background-color: #fffcf5; /* Exact pastel base background */
}

/* ================= HEADER STYLING ================= */
.site-header {
    position: relative;
    background-color: #fffcf5;
    width: 100%;
    z-index: 1000;
}

/* --- 1. Thinner Top Pink Bar --- */
.top-announcement-bar {
    background-color: #ffb6c1; /* Soft pink color */
    color: #2f2e41;
    padding: 6px 5%; /* Sleek thin padding */
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 500;
    border-bottom: 1px dashed rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6);
}

.top-bar-container {
    max-width: 1300px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
}

.top-left-info, .top-right-info {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 12px;
}

.top-left-info i, .top-right-info i {
    color: #ff4757;
}

.top-left-info .dot, .top-right-info .sep {
    color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
}

.top-right-info a {
    color: inherit;
    text-decoration: none;
}

.top-socials {
    display: flex;
    gap: 8px;
}

.top-socials a {
    width: 24px;
    height: 24px;
    background: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #ff4757;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: transform 0.2s ease;
}

.top-socials a:hover {
    transform: scale(1.1);
}

/* --- 2. Main Navigation Bar --- */
.main-navbar {
    background-color: #fffcf5;
    padding: 12px 5%;
}

.nav-container {
    max-width: 1300px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: space-between;
}

.nav-menu {
    list-style: none;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 25px;
    padding: 0;
    margin: 0;
}

.nav-menu a {
    text-decoration: none;
    color: #2f2e41;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 15px;
    position: relative;
    transition: color 0.3s ease;
}

.nav-menu a.active, .nav-menu a:hover {
    color: #ff4757;
}

.nav-menu a.active::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    bottom: -6px;
    left: 0;
    width: 100%;
    height: 3px;
    background-color: #ff4757;
    border-radius: 2px;
}

/* Logo Fix: Seamless blend without background box */
.header-logo-wrapper {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
}

.clean-logo {
    height: 95px;
    width: auto;
    background: transparent !important;
    border-radius: 0 !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    border: none !important;
    object-fit: contain;
    mix-blend-mode: multiply; /* Blends white corners with #fffcf5 background */
}

/* Right Group Actions */
.right-nav-group {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 30px;
}

.nav-actions {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 15px;
}

.search-btn {
    width: 42px;
    height: 42px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 1px solid #ffe3ec;
    background: #ffffff;
    color: #2f2e41;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 15px;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.search-btn:hover {
    background: #ffe3ec;
    color: #ff4757;
}

.btn-order-now {
    background: #ff4757;
    color: #ffffff;
    padding: 10px 24px;
    border-radius: 30px;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 14px;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(255, 71, 87, 0.3);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.btn-order-now:hover {
    background: #e04368;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.mobile-menu-toggle {
    display: none;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    font-size: 22px;
    color: #2f2e41;
    cursor: pointer;
}

/* --- 3. Bottom Umbrella / Scalloped Wave Edge --- */
.umbrella-bottom-border {
    position: relative;
    width: 100%;
    height: 18px;
    line-height: 0;
    background-color: #fffcf5;
}

.umbrella-bottom-border svg {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
}

/* Responsive */
@media (max-width: 992px) {
    .nav-menu, .top-bar-container {
        display: none;
    }
    .mobile-menu-toggle {
        display: block;
    }
}

/* --- Right Side Group --- */

}

.search-btn:hover {

}

    border-radius: 30px;
    text-decoration: none;

}

.order-btn:hover {
    background-color: #e04a7e;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* --- Responsive Layout for Mobile --- */
@media (max-width: 1200px) {
    .nav-container {
        justify-content: flex-start;
        gap: 15px;
    }
    .left-links, .right-links {

        height: 100px;
    }
    .top-bar-container {
        flex-direction: column;
        gap: 10px;
        padding: 10px 20px;
        text-align: center;
    }
}

Haan, bilkul! Main is style ka ek naya, clean aur high-resolution design bana sakta hoon.

Reference image (image_8.png) ke content, layout aur elements ko replicate karte hue, main ek updated, premium-quality graphic design generate karunga:

Key Design Changes from Reference:

  1. Resolution & Clarity: Image 8 bohot pixelated hai. Naya design bilkul sharp, clear aur print-quality resolution (4K+) mein hoga.

  2. Typography & Spelling: Image 8 ke texts ("Cop Worlts", "Aniot Rene") aur description blurred/nonsense hain. Main legible aur relevant terms use karunga (jaise "Cake Waffles" ya "Cupcakes").

  3. Color Depth: Pastel colors (Pink, Cream) ka use toh rahega, par color gradient aur depth ko refined kiya jayega taake items realistic lagein.

  4. Floating Elements: Floating starbursts, sprinkles aur mini shapes ki quality aur variety ko naye, clean textures ke sath update kiya jayega.

Product Description in Naya Design:

Main teesri aur aakhri product (bottom-right) ke description box mein specific textual content add karunga:

  • Heading: Main legible text add karunga (jaise "Cupcakes with Waffles").

  • Paragraph: Legible description add karunga (jaise "Our signature fluffy vanilla cupcakes, topped with white chocolate waffle triangles for a perfect texture and taste, decorated with rainbow sprinkles on the frosting").

  • Bullets/Details: Kuch clear bullet points add honge (jaise "Best for: Birthday Parties | Gift | Evening Snacks").

CSS
/* --- Base Reset & Specialties Global --- */
* {
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
}

body {
    background-color: #fffcf5;
}

.specialties-section {
    padding: 80px 10%;
    background-color: #fff9fb;
}

.specialties-container {
    max-width: 1300px;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

.specialties-title {
    font-family: 'Fredoka One', sans-serif;
    color: #ff4757;
    font-size: 36px;
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 60px;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
}

/* --- Specialties Grid Layout (Reference Replicated) --- */
.specialties-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 50px 70px; /* Wide row gap, large column gap */
}

/* --- Generic Specialty Item Styles --- */
.specialty-item {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 25px;
    position: relative;
    padding: 15px;
}

/* Item Reverse for specific flow */
.item-reverse {
    flex-direction: row-reverse;
}

/* Item details text styling */
.item-details h3 {
    font-size: 20px;
    color: #2f2e41;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
}

.badge {
    font-size: 10px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 2px 6px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    color: #fff;
}

.badge-hot {
    background-color: #ff4757;
}

.item-details p.description {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #666;
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.item-details p.details {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #999;
    font-style: italic;
}

/* Categories & Tags */
.category-tag {
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #ff4757;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
    display: block;
}

/* Bullet list details (Item 3 specific) */
.bullet-details {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    font-size: 11px;
    color: #888;
}

.bullet-details li {
    margin-bottom: 3px;
}

/* --- Item Visuals & Scatter Shapes --- */
.item-visual {
    position: relative;
    width: 250px;
    height: 250px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background-color: #ffeff3;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    overflow: visible;
}

.item-visual img {
    max-width: 90%;
    max-height: 90%;
    object-fit: contain;
    mix-blend-mode: multiply; /* Blends white corners with base cream background */
}

/* Small floating scatter elements */
.floating-scatter {
    position: absolute;
    width: 25px;
    height: 25px;
    border-radius: 5px;
    z-index: 5;
    opacity: 0.6;
}

.small-scatter-1 {
    top: 10px;
    left: 20px;
    background-color: #ffe3ec;
}

.small-scatter-2 {
    bottom: 20px;
    right: 30px;
    background-color: #ffdce5;
}

.small-scatter-3 {
    top: 30px;
    right: 20px;
    background-color: #ffeff3;
}

/* --- Specific Grid Item Positions & Sizing (Scaling per prompt) --- */

/* 1. Cupcake & Waffle Stack (Cop Worlts style) */
.grid-item-1 {
    grid-column: 1 / 2;
    grid-row: 1 / 2;
}

/* 2. Mini Cupcakes (Cop Worlts style, scaled down) */
.grid-item-2 {
    grid-column: 2 / 3;
    grid-row: 1 / 2;
    transform: scale(0.9); /* Scaled down */
    align-self: end; /* Offset positioning per prompt */
}

/* 3. Cupcake with Waffle (Aniot Rene style, scaled up with text) */
.grid-item-3 {
    grid-column: 1 / 3; /* Full width row spanning 2 columns */
    grid-row: 2 / 3;
    margin-top: 30px; /* Offset spacing */
}

.scaled-up {
    transform: scale(1.1); /* Scaled up */
}

.scaled-up .item-visual {
    width: 280px;
    height: 280px;
    background-color: #ffdce5; /* Slightly darker pink accent */
}

.scaled-up .item-details {
    max-width: 45%; /* Limits description text width */
}

/* Mobile Responsive Adjustments */
@media (max-width: 1024px) {
    .specialties-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 40px;
    }

    .grid-item-1, .grid-item-2, .grid-item-3 {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
        grid-row: auto;
    }

    .grid-item-2, .scaled-up {
        transform: scale(1); /* Reset scaling on mobile */
    }
}

2. CSS Code (style.css mein add karein)

Saari classes tb-spec- se start hoti hain isliye yeh aapki baaki CSS ke sath conflict nahi karegi:

CSS
/* ================= UNIQUE PREFIXED SPECIALTIES SECTION CSS ================= */
.tb-spec-section {
    padding: 90px 5%;
    background-color: #fff9fb; /* Match pastel theme base */
    position: relative;
    overflow: hidden;
}

.tb-spec-container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Section Header */
.tb-spec-header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 60px;
}

.tb-spec-subtitle {
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ff4757;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.tb-spec-main-title {
    font-family: 'Fredoka One', 'Poppins', sans-serif;
    color: #2f2e41;
    font-size: 38px;
    letter-spacing: 0.5px;
}

/* Grid Layout */
.tb-spec-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 40px 60px;
}

/* Individual Card Styling */
.tb-spec-card {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 25px;
    background: transparent;
    padding: 10px;
}

/* Circular Pastel Visual Container */
.tb-spec-circle-bg {
    position: relative;
    width: 230px;
    height: 230px;
    min-width: 230px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background-color: #ffeff3;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.25);
}

.tb-spec-img {
    max-width: 85%;
    max-height: 85%;
    object-fit: contain;
    mix-blend-mode: multiply; /* Blends white image background with pastel circle */
    transition: transform 0.4s ease;
}

.tb-spec-card:hover .tb-spec-img {
    transform: scale(1.06);
}

/* Floating decorative dots */
.tb-spec-floating-dot {
    position: absolute;
    width: 18px;
    height: 18px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    opacity: 0.7;
}
.dot-1 { top: 15px; left: 20px; background-color: #ffdce5; }
.dot-2 { bottom: 20px; right: 25px; background-color: #ffe3ec; }
.dot-3 { top: 25px; right: 20px; background-color: #ffb6c1; }

/* Content Styling */
.tb-spec-badge {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 11px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff;
    background-color: #ff4757;
    padding: 3px 10px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.tb-spec-tag {
    font-size: 12px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #ff4757;
    margin-bottom: 5px;
    display: block;
}

.tb-spec-title {
    font-size: 22px;
    color: #2f2e41;
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.tb-spec-desc {
    font-size: 13.5px;
    color: #666575;
    line-height: 1.6;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
}

.tb-spec-subtext {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #9997a5;
    font-style: italic;
}

/* Bullet list for featured item */
.tb-spec-bullet-list {
    list-style: none;
    padding: 0;
    margin-top: 10px;
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #555;
}

.tb-spec-bullet-list li {
    margin-bottom: 4px;
}

/* Specific Positions and Scaling */
.tb-spec-item-1 {
    grid-column: 1 / 2;
    grid-row: 1 / 2;
}

.tb-spec-item-2 {
    grid-column: 2 / 3;
    grid-row: 1 / 2;
    transform: translateY(20px); /* Slight offset for aesthetic alignment */
}

/* Bottom Featured Card (Spans across both columns and scaled up) */
.tb-spec-card-featured {
    grid-column: 1 / 3;
    grid-row: 2 / 3;
    margin-top: 20px;
    background: #ffffff;
    padding: 30px;
    border-radius: 25px;
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.3);
}

.tb-spec-card-featured .tb-spec-circle-bg {
    width: 270px;
    height: 270px;
    min-width: 270px;
    background-color: #ffdce5;
}

.tb-spec-card-featured .tb-spec-content {
    max-width: 550px;
}

/* Responsive Design for Mobile & Tablets */
@media (max-width: 992px) {
    .tb-spec-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 30px;
    }
    .tb-spec-item-1, .tb-spec-item-2, .tb-spec-card-featured {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
        grid-row: auto;
        transform: none;
    }
    .tb-spec-card, .tb-spec-card-featured {
        flex-direction: column;
        text-align: center;
        padding: 20px;
    }
    .tb-spec-circle-bg {
        width: 200px;
        height: 200px;
        min-width: 200px;
        margin: 0 auto;
    }
}

2. CSS Code (style.css mein add karein)

CSS
/* ================= UNIQUE STORY SECTION CSS ================= */
.tb-story-section {
    background-color: #f7f3eb; /* Warm beige/cream tone matching reference */
    padding: 85px 5%;
    font-family: 'Poppins', sans-serif;
}

.tb-story-container {
    max-width: 1200px;
    margin: 0 auto;
}

/* Top Grid: Left Text, Right Large Rounded Image */
.tb-story-top-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.1fr;
    gap: 60px;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 70px;
}

.tb-story-tag {
    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: 2px;
    color: #8c7865;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    font-weight: 500;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.tb-story-title {
    font-size: 40px;
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', 'Poppins', serif;
    color: #2b2621;
    line-height: 1.2;
    margin-bottom: 20px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.tb-story-desc {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #6b625b;
    line-height: 1.7;
    margin-bottom: 30px;
    max-width: 480px;
}

/* Outline Button Style */
.tb-story-btn {
    display: inline-block;
    padding: 12px 32px;
    border: 1px solid #8c7865;
    border-radius: 30px;
    color: #2b2621;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 12.5px;
    font-weight: 600;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.tb-story-btn:hover {
    background-color: #2b2621;
    color: #ffffff;
    border-color: #2b2621;
}

/* Big Rounded Image Box */
.tb-story-image-box {
    width: 100%;
    height: 380px;
    border-radius: 30px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05);
}

.tb-story-image-box img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
}

/* Bottom Grid: 3 Columns */
.tb-story-bottom-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 30px;
}

.tb-story-feature-card {
    padding: 25px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    background: transparent;
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease;
}

/* Highlighted Box Card (First item background matching image) */
.tb-story-highlight {
    background-color: #e3d3c2; 
    box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.03);
}

.tb-story-card-title {
    font-size: 17px;
    color: #2b2621;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
}

.tb-story-card-desc {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #6b625b;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 992px) {
    .tb-story-top-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 40px;
    }
    .tb-story-image-box {
        height: 280px;
    }
    .tb-story-bottom-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 20px;
    }
}

    gap: 50px;
    align-items: center;
    margin-bottom: 60px;
}

.tb-story-tag {
    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: 1.5px;
    color: #ff4757;
    display: block;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
    text-transform: uppercase;
}

.tb-story-title {
    font-size: 38px;
    font-family: 'Fredoka One', 'Poppins', sans-serif;
    color: #2f2e41;
    line-height: 1.25;
    margin-bottom: 18px;
}

.tb-story-desc {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: #666575;
    line-height: 1.7;
    margin-bottom: 25px;
}

/* Enhanced Primary Button Matching Header CTA */
.tb-story-btn {
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 12px 28px;
    background-color: #ff4757;
    color: #ffffff;
    border-radius: 30px;
    text-decoration: none;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    box-shadow: 0 5px 15px rgba(255, 71, 87, 0.3);
    transition: all 0.3s ease;
}

.tb-story-btn:hover {
    background-color: #e04368;
    transform: translateY(-2px);
}

/* Big Rounded Image Box with Pastel Glow Shadow */
.tb-story-image-box {
    width: 100%;
    height: 380px;
    border-radius: 25px;
    overflow: hidden;
    box-shadow: 0 15px 35px rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.25);
    border: 4px solid #ffffff;
}

.tb-story-image-box img {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    object-fit: cover;
    transition: transform 0.5s ease;
}

.tb-story-image-box:hover img {
    transform: scale(1.03);
}

/* Bottom Grid: 3 Columns */
.tb-story-bottom-grid {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
    gap: 30px;
}

.tb-story-feature-card {
    padding: 30px 25px;
    border-radius: 20px;
    background: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.2);
    box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.02);
    transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease;
}

.tb-story-feature-card:hover {
    transform: translateY(-5px);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 30px rgba(255, 182, 193, 0.25);
}

/* Highlighted Soft Pink Card */
.tb-story-highlight {
    background-color: #ffeff3; 
    border-color: #ffdce5;
}

.tb-story-card-title {
    font-size: 18px;
    color: #2f2e41;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    font-weight: 700;
}

.tb-story-card-desc {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: #666575;
    line-height: 1.6;
}

/* Responsive Design */
@media (max-width: 992px) {
    .tb-story-top-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 40px;
    }
    .tb-story-image-box {
        height: 280px;
    }
    .tb-story-bottom-grid {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: 20px;
    }
}
